services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: If anyone knows how to have an event, it is the New Mexico Museum of Art…we’ve been doing it for over a century! Located on Santa Fe’s historic plaza, the Museum of Art is admired for its New Mexico Pueblo Revival style architecture and is listed as a national historic landmark. “There is no more beautiful place to hold an event than at the historic St. Francis Auditorium. The historic allure and iconic frescos would be enough to recommend it, but the staff is also top notch. The event staff and security are always helpful and ready to solve any problem that arises. Pure Santa Fe!” The Saint Francis auditorium has been a centerpiece of Santa Fe’s cultural and social life as a community
